validity.recommendation: Leave Diameter blank as recorded -- Texas to Louisiana Energy Pathway (TLEP) builds no new pipe; capacity comes from one new compressor station, modifications to two existing compressor stations, and converting existing IT Feeder System/turnback capacity to firm service. LengthKnownKm=0 is already correct. No action needed.
validity.researcher_notes: FERC's Notice of Availability of the EA for the Texas to Louisiana Energy Pathway Project (Docket CP22-495, https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2023/06/15/2023-12815/transcontinental-gas-pipe-line-company-llc-notice-of-availability-of-the-environmental-assessment, fetched and read directly) states in full: 'Transco requests authorization to construct and operate one new 15,900-horsepower compressor station in Fort Bend County, Texas (Compressor Station 33); modify six existing compressors at Compressor Station 40 in Hardin County, Texas; and perform programming updates at existing Compressor Station 23 in Victoria County, Texas... through incremental capacity as a result of Project construction, the conversion of "IT Feeder System" capacity to firm capacity, the "turnback" of certain firm transportation capacity by customers.' No pipeline segment or diameter is listed anywhere in the notice. Second, independent source: Troutman Pepper's law-firm reporting on the certificate order describes the same compression/conversion-only scope (https://www.troutmanenergyreport.com/2024/03/ferc-grants-certificate-to-transcos-texas-to-louisiana-energy-pathway-project/). Per the standing compression-only rule, the sheet's blank Diameter is the correct, confirmed value.
